title: Detecting Hidden Misalignment via SAE Feature Monitoring: A Controlled Test
original_idea: Fine-tune GPT-2 Small to be 'deceptively misaligned' with a hidden trigger. Train SAEs on base and fine-tuned model. Test whether new features in the fine-tuned model activate on trigger-containing prompts.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests the minimal viable version of detecting deceptive alignment with SAEs. Central safety question with clear falsifiable prediction.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning GPT-2 Small with a backdoor, training two SAEs, and performing comparative feature analysis. Multi-step pipeline challenging for beginners in 30hrs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple stages: fine-tuning, SAE training x2, feature comparison. Each stage has its own complexity. Broader than it appears.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
